tool_input.command: sed -n '1,260p' src/session.js && sed -n '1,200p' package.json && sed -n '1,240p' README.md
git status --short && git log --oneline -5 && nl -ba src/session.js

/runtime/node --input-type=module -e "import { Session } from './src/session.js'; const tick=()=>Promise.resolve(); let calls=0; const s=new Session({queryFn:c=>{calls++; return c.signal.aborted?'aborted':'ok'},timers:{schedule(){}}},{online:false}); const h=s.subscribe('fresh'); if(s.snapshot('fresh').fetchStatus!=='paused')throw Error('fresh should pause'); s.unsubscribe(h); s.online(true); await tick(); if(calls!==0)throw Error('retired fresh attempt invoked'); if(s.snapshot('fresh').fetchStatus!=='idle')throw Error('cancel did not restore idle'); let cachedCalls=0; const c=new Session({queryFn:()=>++cachedCalls,timers:{schedule(){}}}); c.subscribe('cached'); await tick(); const h2=c.subscribe('cached'); c.online(false); c.unsubscribe(h2); c.online(true); await tick(); if(cachedCalls!==2)throw Error('cached paused refresh did not resume'); let observed; let settle; const p=new Promise(r=>settle=r); const a=new Session({queryFn:ctx=>{observed=ctx.signal; return p},timers:{schedule(){}}}); const ha=a.subscribe('abort'); a.unsubscribe(ha); if(!observed.aborted)throw Error('consumed request was not aborted'); settle('late'); await tick(); if(a.snapshot('abort').status!=='pending'||a.snapshot('abort').fetchStatus!=='idle')throw Error('late result overwrote cancelled attempt'); console.log('lifecycle checks passed')"
